meta.title: 文房 — Wénfáng · Quiet tools for studying Chinese.
meta.description: A small library of focused, single-purpose tools for students of Chinese — Hanyu Jiaocheng flashcards and stroke-order playback.

hero.deck: A small library of focused, single-purpose instruments — flashcards bound to the textbook on your shelf, stroke-order playback for any character you can paste in. Built slowly, kept honest, kept free.
hero.imageAlt: Inkwash brush painting of a young xian-style scholar standing on a misty mountain peak

tip.translation: The sea of learning has no shore.
tip.noteHtml: From a couplet attributed to the Tang scholar 韩愈 (Han Yu, 768–824). The full saying — 学海无涯苦作舟 — "the sea of learning has no shore; let toil be your boat" — has been a refrain for Chinese students for a thousand years. A useful thing to keep on the wall above a desk.

principles.headlinePre: Built like a stationery shop, not

items.title: One thing per tool.
items.body: Each instrument does a single job and stops. No accounts, no streaks, no leaderboard. The textbook on your shelf already sets the curriculum.

items.title: Match the textbook.
items.body: Cards are bound to the exact vocabulary list of Hanyu Jiaocheng volumes 1A through 3B. The tool follows your study, not its own.

items.title: Honest defaults.
items.body: If we don't have stroke data for a character, we say so plainly. A short, true note is worth more than a generated GIF that's wrong.

items.title: Quiet on the page.
items.body: No popovers, no notifications, no banner ads, no dark patterns. Cream paper, one accent, generous margins. Study in peace.
